description:
Nearest cross street: Between Overton Road and Bertha Road
Dimensions of the Property: 10.258 acres or 446,838 square feet, mostly rectangular with 261.47 feet of frontage on Harmony Road
Type of Property: Commercial property consisting f three buildings occupied by (a) a TD Bank branch, (b) The Goddard School, and (c) a fitness center operated by an affiliate of
the Property owner. The Property also includes about 1.75 acres of vacant land and another 1.88 acres of woods and wetlands.
Upset Price: the full judgment amount $5,158,153.09
Plaintiff reserves the right to adjust the upset price prior to the sale. Plaintiff will advise the Sheriff in advance of the sale should the upset price change.
